Attention & presence

A useful starting sequence

The aim is not a perfect screen-time score. It is a workable relationship with your attention, your responsibilities, and the people and places around you.

Essay · 4 min read

What is the time you save actually for?

Before adding another automation, decide what the recovered time is meant to make possible and count the work the tool creates.

Practical guide · 3 min read

A quiet morning does not need a dashboard

Choose one manageable boundary around attention while preserving the technology you need for care, access, work, and safety.

Essay · 3 min read

When does documenting your life get in the way of experiencing it?

Choose what to record, what to keep private, and when to put the camera away without treating documentation as either all good or all bad.
